jsonld.description: Real-time HTTP POST webhook dispatch engine running directly inside Google Sheets to send row events to Slack, Discord, and REST endpoints.
featureList: Instant and scheduled HTTP POST webhook dispatches from Google Sheets
Built-in presets for Slack Incoming Webhooks, Discord Channels, and Zapier/Make
Column-level edit filtering and trigger conditions
Automated installable onEdit and onChange background triggers
Custom HTTP headers support for Bearer tokens and API keys
Audit writeback column to log dispatch timestamps and prevent duplicate alerts
LockService mutex concurrency protection against race conditions
Non-restricted OAuth scopes — zero CASA Tier 2 audit fees
One-time lifetime license — zero recurring monthly task fees
